name: Chest of Cedar
body:
Aura faint abjuration; CL 6th; Slot —; Price 4,000 gp; Weight 10 lb.

DESCRIPTION

About Magic Perfumes Magic perfumes act as other perfumes. They last for 4 hours and make it easier for creatures with scent to notice or track you. Their effects operate in an aura of 10 ft. (or 5 ft. outdoors) centered on you. Detect magic reveals the aura.

This large box of naturally fragrant wood is further imbued with scented oils. All clothing kept within it for at least 24 hours magically takes on the chest’s aromas. Most cedar chests can hold four shirts at one time.

Wearing the clothes grants you a +4 resistance bonus to saves against nausea-inducing odors for 8 hours.

Any clothing so affected also radiates faint abjuration magic.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Spells resistance; Cost 2,000 gp
